analysis.themes: Schoolgirls vanish into an ancient rock formation on a Valentine's Day picnic — Victorian repression dissolving into a nature that neither explains nor apologizes.
analysis.atmosphere: Golden-haze eeriness; the film is beautiful in a way that feels like a warning, and dread arrives through serenity.
analysis.narrative: A mystery that refuses to be one — no culprit, no solution, only aftermath. The withholding is the meaning.
analysis.visual: Hazy telephoto pastoral imagery makes the Australian bush feel sentient; few films make landscape this quietly menacing.
analysis.characters: The vanished girls are idealized into myth; those left behind — the headmistress, the survivors — crack under not knowing.
